data.assessment: Utility is far apart: A 25.2, B 25.4, C 10.2, a gap of 15.2, even though C has the best on-time rate (0.99). The cause is sanctions, not deliveries. C carries 18.2 of the 20.0 sanction points, from release overstays (19.0 Minor violations) and blocking_guard evictions (7.0 Major) under block_k=2 from D1. A never parks on the road but absorbs the most blocked time (556 s), so the road advantage and its cost fall on different companies. On-time delivery is near full (80.8/82.6, 0 unfinished), and every company is well above the 0.8 floor, so there is room to pursue fairness.

proposals.title: Raise hold_limit 60s -> 70s (rule)
proposals.rationale: Release-deadline overstays (19.0 per period) are the largest violation source and fall mostly on C, which parks to wait for orders. In the quiet season a 10 s longer allowance should cut Minor sanctions, raising C's utility and shrinking utility_gap and sanction_total, with little effect on on-time deliveries. A may lose some time to longer parking (it already has 556 s blocked), so watch on_time_rate_gap. Vote: C and likely B yes, A uncertain, so it should pass with quorum 2.
proposals.cadl:
# =====================================================================
# robot_town.cadl ─── ロボットの街：3 社の配送ロボットが道路を共有する
#
# 道路網はラズパイマウスのシミュレータと同じ 11 ノード・17 エッジ。
# 3 社（A / B / C）が 2 台ずつロボットを走らせ、ノードは 1 台ずつしか
# 使えない。仕事のないロボットは車庫に戻るか、道路上（中央の交差点 8）
# に止まって次の注文を待つ。止まったロボットは他社の通行をふさぐ。
#
# `# @amend:<名前>` が付いた行は、改正してよいパラメータ。どの層（規則・
# 契約）に属し、どこまで動かしてよいかは constitution.yaml が決める。
# 委員会（COUNCIL）が自分で改正できるのは規則の層だけで、契約の層を
# 変えるには人間の判断が要る。
# =====================================================================

sos:
  name: "RobotTown"
  type: Collaborative             # 独立した 3 社が共通の規則を決める
  version: "1.0.0"

  context:
    environment:
      num_robots:   6
      num_companies: 3
      time_step_ms: 1000

  actors:
    - id: TOWN_STEWARD
      role: "road_steward"
      autonomy: low
      capabilities: [assign_order, record_violation, evict]
      interface:
        input:  [order_request, position_report, node_released, rule_update]
        output: [order_assignment, eviction_notice, regime_notice, violation_report]

    - id: "ROBOT[1..N]"
      role: "delivery_robot"
      autonomy: high
      capabilities: [move, park, pickup, dropoff]
      interface:
        input:  [order_assignment, eviction_notice, regime_notice, amendment_proposal]
        output: [position_report, node_released, ballot]

    - id: COUNCIL
      role: "rule_amendment_body"
      autonomy: medium
      capabilities: [propose_amendment, tally_ballots]
      interface:
        input:  [violation_report, ballot]
        output: [amendment_proposal, rule_update]

  contracts:
    # ── 顧客への約束：注文 1 件ごとのインスタンス（契約の層。人間が決める） ──
    - id: DELIVERY_SLA
      parties: [TOWN_STEWARD, "ROBOT[*]"]
      guarantee:
        - "pickup_time <= 120s"         # @amend:pickup_deadline
        - "dropoff_time <= 120s"        # @amend:dropoff_deadline
      lifecycle:
        states: [Assigned, PickedUp, Delivered, Late]
        initial: Assigned
        terminal: [Delivered, Late]
        transitions:
          - id: pickup
            from: Assigned
            to:   PickedUp
            on:   "ROBOT[i].status == PickedUp"
            deadline: 120s            # @amend:pickup_deadline
            on_violation: { transition: Late, severity: Major }
          - id: dropoff
            from: PickedUp
            to:   Delivered
            on:   "ROBOT[i].status == Delivered"
            deadline: 120s            # @amend:dropoff_deadline
            on_violation: { transition: Late, severity: Major }

    # ── 道路の使い方：道路上に止まるたびに 1 インスタンス ──
    - id: ROAD_USE
      parties: [TOWN_STEWARD, "ROBOT[*]", COUNCIL]
      guarantee:
        - "hold_time <= hold_limit"
      authority:
        decision_holder: COUNCIL
        beta: 0.5
        mode: "collective"
      information:
        alpha: 1.0                    # 規則と違反記録は全社に公開
      incentives:
        type: sanction
        lambda: 0.5                   # @amend:sanction_lambda
        rules:
          - "penalty(ROBOT[i], lambda) when overstay"
      lifecycle:
        states: [Holding, Overstay, Released, Evicted]
        initial: Holding
        terminal: [Released, Evicted]
        transitions:
          - id: release
            from: [Holding, Overstay]
            to:   Released
            on:   "ROBOT[i] -> TOWN_STEWARD : node_released"
            deadline: 70s             # @amend:hold_limit
            on_violation: { transition: Overstay, severity: Minor }
      monitors:
        - id: blocking_guard
          observe: "ROBOT[i].blocking"
          sampling: periodic(1000ms)
          rule: "ROBOT.blocking >= 2 AND state IN [Holding, Overstay]"  # @amend:block_k
          on_match: { transition: Evicted, severity: Major }

  # ── 運用モード：分散（各社が道路上で待つ）⇄ 集中（管理者が待避所を割り当てる） ──
  # 条件は 5 分ごとに、直前 5 分の観測で判定する。
  #   orders_in_window : 3 社の注文の合計件数
  #   blocked_pct      : ロボットが止まっているロボットにふさがれていた時間の割合（%）
  # 集中管理は交差点をふさがれない反面、エッジを 1 台ずつ割り当てるので、
  # 注文が非常に多いと許可待ちが積み重なる。そのときだけ分散に戻す。
  transitions:
    - from: DISTRIBUTED
      to: CENTRALIZED
      condition: "orders_in_window < 22"      # @amend:to_central
      protocol: SWITCH
      safety_invariant: "robots_on_road == 0"
    - from: CENTRALIZED
      to: DISTRIBUTED
      condition: "orders_in_window >= 26"     # @amend:to_distributed
      protocol: SWITCH

  protocols:
    - id: SWITCH
      trigger: "regime_condition_holds"
      steps:
        - "TOWN_STEWARD -> ROBOT[*] : regime_notice"
        - "ROBOT[*] -> TOWN_STEWARD : node_released"
        - "TOWN_STEWARD : activate_regime"
    - id: AMEND
      trigger: "period_end"
      steps:
        - "TOWN_STEWARD -> COUNCIL : violation_report"
        - "COUNCIL -> ROBOT[*] : amendment_proposal"
        - "ROBOT[*] -> COUNCIL : ballot"
        - "COUNCIL : tally_ballots"
        - "COUNCIL -> TOWN_STEWARD : rule_update"

  metrics:
    - id: on_time_deliveries
      formula: "count(Delivered)"
      target: ">= 0.9 * count(orders)"
    - id: blocked_time
      formula: "sum(blocked_robot_seconds)"
      target: "<= 600s"

proposals.title: Re-measure D1: block_k 2 -> 3 (rule, reverses a human decision)
proposals.rationale: This answers the re-measurement promised in D1 and flagged by the KPI change. blocking_guard evictions (7.0 Major, 1.5 points each, 10.5 in total) fall mostly on C, and D1 cut C's utility from 28.8 to 19.0. Returning to 3 should cut C's sanctions and narrow utility_gap and sanction_total. The new risk is longer blocking of A, but late deliveries were the reason for D1, and they matter less in the quiet season. Vote: C and B likely yes (both park on the road), A likely no, so quorum 2 is probably met.

proposals.why_human: This reverses D1, which a human adopted against B's and C's votes on the principle that waiting at intersections is no company's right. Whether that principle still holds under the fairness KPI is a value judgment for the human, not something the gates can settle. The human should weigh C's sanction relief against A's blocked time (556 s) and the late deliveries that D1 removed.

proposals.title: Lower sanction_lambda 0.5 -> 0.0 (rule)
proposals.rationale: All 20 sanction points come from road violations and 91% fall on C, so removing the multiplier would bring utility close to on-time counts (about 25 vs 25 vs 28). utility_gap would collapse and sanction_total would fall to 0. However, the gap would then close by removing deterrence, not by fair road use. C, which parks and has the least blocked time (157 s), would keep its road advantage for free, while A carries the most blocked time (556 s) without compensation. Vote: C and B yes, A likely no, so it passes the vote.

That may be exactly the Goodhart pattern the KPI warns against: no company should gain because of how the road is used. Whether sanctions-free parking is acceptable is a policy choice the gates cannot judge.
